model.name: Folders are drop targets — dropping content onto a folder places it inside that folder
model.description: Tron INTENT (capability, does NOT exist today): folders SHOULD BE drop targets; dropping content onto a folder places it INSIDE that folder. Currently folders are NOT drop targets (Tron dropped on the drop area, not a folder — see R40.85 regression). Frame as the BEHAVIOUR (folders accept drops + the dropped content lands in that folder), NOT merely fix-the-upload. Same CONTAINMENT theme as R40.83 (room-folder identity) + R40.84 (in-place add). User terms: when I drop content onto a folder, it lands inside that folder.

discoverySource.framing: CAPABILITY Tron wants (does not exist today), NOT a defect; PO split it from the R40.85 upload regression.

model.buildable: capability (new) — builds ON the fixed drop-area upload (R40.85); same room-folder containment surface.
model.crossRefNote: Containment family: R40.83 (resolve the destination folder by ONE identity), R40.84 (in-place tree update on the drop-add), R40.85 (the fixed upload path this builds on), R40.78 (add-folder-in-room containment). Ties the unit-IS-the-MVC-model + drop-resolves-destination-by-one-identity lessons.
model.satisfactionStatus: UNVERIFIED (captured; drop-target capability unbuilt; no stub RED observed).

acceptanceCriteria.text: A folder ACCEPTS a drop — it is a valid drop target with a drop affordance. Today folders are NOT drop targets; this adds it.

gateRef.assertion: a folder is a drop target (accepts + shows affordance); non-target => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: assert a folder is not-yet a drop target (current) -> RED before the feature

acceptanceCriteria.text: Tron: dropping content onto a folder places it INSIDE that folder. Dropped content lands in the TARGET folder (containment), NOT at root or elsewhere. User terms: when I drop content onto a folder, it lands inside that folder.

gateRef.assertion: dropped content is contained in the target folder; landing at root/elsewhere => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed a drop landing outside the target -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: The drop resolves the DESTINATION folder by the ONE canonical roomcoll identity (R40.83 lesson) — NOT a second/dual identity for the drop target. A wrong-destination from a divergent identity resolution => RED.

gateRef.assertion: the drop target resolves via the one roomcoll identity (RoomFolder); a dual/second-identity resolution => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed a dual-identity drop-target resolution -> wrong dest -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: The drop-add updates the target node IN PLACE (R40.84): the tree does not collapse or rebuild wholesale, expanded state survives, only the target folder gains the child.

gateRef.assertion: drop-into-folder updates that node in place; full-tree collapse/rebuild => RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: WE verify @390 member-session (drop content onto a folder -> it lands inside). Tron ACCEPTS delivered verified work (NOT Tron-verified).

gateRef.assertion: WE verify drop-into-folder containment before Tron sees it; Tron accepts

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: N/A (acceptance; failable via containment + in-place + stub gates)

acceptanceCriteria.text: Seed a drop onto a folder that lands at ROOT or elsewhere (not inside the target) => RED. A suite green on lands-outside-the-target is inadmissible.

gateRef.assertion: the seeded lands-outside is observed RED before the feature counts
